value.rationale: Natural previously unmeasured metric invariant of a well-studied full-dimensional complete bipartite total matching polytope, with explicit unique incenter and a sharp n=4 global-to-local contact-facet transition. The uniform screening of all nonbalanced lifted facet types is the structural content needed to obtain the exact geometric classification; the result is not merely a numerical restatement of the published H-description. It provides a geometric benchmark for total-matching polytope realizations and contact geometry in an infinite family.
